basic_details.job_title: NIA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 50 LDC, Stenographer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Investigation Agency (NIA) has released the recruitment notification for 50 Ministerial Staff vacancies on a deputation basis, comprising Senior Private Secretary, Section Officer/ Office Superintendent, Assistant, Accountant, Stenographer Grade-I, Stenographer Grade-II, Upper Division Clerk (UDC), and Lower Division Clerk (LDC). Qualifications and pay levels vary by post, with pay scales ranging from Level-4 to Level-8, alongside a Special Security Allowance of 20% of basic pay. Applications must be sent offline through the proper channel to DIG (Admin), NIA Hqrs, CGO Complex, Lodhi

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 25 November 2026 (Within 02 months from the date of publication in Employment News)

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The maximum age-limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed fifty-six years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

qualification.details: Post Qualification Required Senior Private Secretary Officers of the Stenographer's cadre under the Central Government or State Governments or Union territories: (a)(i) holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with two years' service in level-7 (Rs. 44900-142400) in the pay matrix; or (b) Possessing a graduate degree from a recognised University. Section Officer/ Office Superintendent Officers under Central/State Government/UTs: (a)(i) Holding analogous posts on regular basis; or (ii) With five years' service in level-6 (Rs. 35,400-1,12,400/-); and (b) Bachelors' Degree from a recognized University and computer proficiency in word processing, spreadsheet, slide generation certified by cadre controlling authority. Assistant Officers of Central Government, State Government or UTs: (a)(i) holding analogous posts on regular basis; or (ii) with six years' service in level-5 (Rs. 29200-92300); and (b) Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University and passed computer proficiency test prescribed by Staff Selection Commission. selection_process: Selection for the Ministerial Staff posts in NIA is conducted through deputation basis
how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria and download the prescribed Bio-data proforma (Annexure-II) from the official NIA website at www.nia.gov.in/recruitment-notice.htm.
Fill out the bio-data form completely and get it duly countersigned and stamped by the competent authority / employer / cadre controlling authority.
Gather photocopies of the APAR dossier from the years 2021-22 to 2025-26, duly attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary of the Govt of India or above.
Ensure the application includes the Department Enquiry/Vigilance clearance certificate, Integrity certificate, and details of major/minor penalties imposed during the last 10 years.

Forward the complete nomination through proper channel to the DIG (Admin), NIA Hqrs, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003 within 02 months from the date of publication in Employment News (by 25 November 2026).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process and Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: Selection for the Ministerial Staff posts in NIA is conducted through deputation basis, accompanied by document verification, APAR assessment, and vigilance clearance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIA Ministerial Staff
content_sections.text: Check eligibility criteria and download the prescribed Bio-data proforma (Annexure-II) from the official NIA website at www.nia.gov.in/recruitment-notice.htm. Fill out the bio-data form completely and get it duly countersigned and stamped by the competent authority / employer / cadre controlling authority. Gather photocopies of the APAR dossier from the years 2021-22 to 2025-26, duly attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary of the Govt of India or above. Ensure the application includes the Department Enquiry/Vigilance clearance certificate, Integrity certificate, and details of major/minor penalties imposed during the last 10 years. Forward the complete nomination through proper channel to the DIG (Admin), NIA Hqrs, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003 within 02 months from the date of publication in Employment News (by 25 November 2026).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIA Ministerial Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications through proper channel is 25 November 2026, which is within 02 months from the date of publication in the Employment News.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the basic pay?
faq.answer: Yes, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TPT), and other allowances are admissible as per Central Government orders from time to time, alongside a Special Security Allowance of 20% of basic pay.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for these deputation posts?
faq.answer: Officers under the Central Government, State Governments, or Union Territories who hold analogous posts on a regular basis or meet specific service length requirements in feeder grades along with the required educational qualifications are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age-limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed fifty-six years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be enclosed with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose bio-data in the prescribed proforma duly countersigned, attested photocopies of APAR dossier for the years 2021-22 to 2025-26, Department Enquiry/Vigilance clearance certificate, Integrity certificate, and details of major/minor penalties imposed during the last 10 years.
